wel.catsNote: Untick any category you don’t need. You can add or remove categories later.
wel.install.title: Install the app
wel.install.lead: Add it to your home screen so it opens like an app and works offline.
wel.install.iphoneSteps: Open the site in Safari, tap Share, then “Add to Home Screen”.
wel.install.androidSteps: Open the site in Chrome, tap the ⋮ menu, then “Install app”.
wel.mode.title: Where is your data kept?
wel.mode.localNote: Your data stays on this device only. Take a backup from Settings now and then.
wel.mode.syncNote: Encrypted sync between your devices through a private GitHub repository. Needs a GitHub token and a passphrase.
wel.connectedData: Connected. Your synced data was found and will be used instead of the categories and salary from the earlier step.
wel.needTest: Test the connection first, or choose “Local”.
adv.title: Advanced settings
set.lead: Settings for this device only; they are never synced.
set.custom.title: Pick your colours
set.restoreNote: Restoring merges the backup into your current data; nothing is removed.
sync.token: GitHub token (access to the data repository only)
sync.pass: Main passphrase (kept on this device only, never uploaded)
sync.off: Sync is off. Your data is on this device only.
sync.never: Sync is on; nothing has been synced yet.
sync.needBoth: Enter the token and the passphrase
sync.err.wrong-passphrase: The passphrase doesn’t match the uploaded data, so nothing was uploaded. Use the same passphrase as on your other devices.
sync.err.bad-envelope: The sync file on GitHub is damaged or not from Toolbox, so nothing was uploaded.
sync.err.update-app: The synced data was saved by a newer version of Toolbox, so nothing was uploaded. Update the app (reopen it) and try again.
sync.err.bad-token: GitHub refused the token: it may have expired or lack access to the repository, or the GitHub rate limit was reached. Create a new token or try again later.
sync.err.offline: You’re offline. Your data is saved on this device and will sync later.
sync.err.conflict: The data changed on another device during sync. Please try again.
sync.err.repo-not-found: The toolbox-data repository wasn’t found. Check its name and the token’s access to it.
toast.syncStopped: Sync stopped; the token and passphrase were removed from this device
toast.restored: Backup restored and merged into your data
err.bad-backup: This file isn’t a valid Toolbox backup
home.backup: It’s been over 30 days without a backup. Take one now so your data stays safe.
set.cantSave: Settings can’t be saved on this device right now because they couldn’t be read. Your changes last until you close the app.
